title: DalleDress
tagline: A generative AI NFT mint framework built on Frog Frames for Warpcast
description: DalleDressA generative NFT mint framework built on Frog Frames for Warpcast. It looks at the users wallet address and parse out information to generate a DALLE image in a style of art by Thomas Jay Rush of Trueblocks. User pay 0.0001 ETH to generate and 0.005 ETH to mint their DalleDress
how_its_made: Trueblocks is used for handling the address. A server was creating for handling requests to generate images. This is connected to a Frame built with Frog. The project also has a solidity contract for minting the images as NFTs onchain. This project also uses DALLE for the generative images.
